definitions.book: per test date: long pred>=q90 EW / short pred<=q10 EW, 0.5 notional per side, daily rebalance; cost = 5bps one-way on traded notional per leg (turnover = 0.5*sum|w_new-w_old| per leg); first day of a run is full entry. Days with <20 assets skipped.
definitions.embargo: train rows in the last 5 days before each fold boundary dropped (5d label overlap); same embargo at inner CV boundaries
definitions.funding_level: raw last_funding_rate x 1e4 (bps per funding interval); null -> 0.0, rate reported
definitions.funding_pct: per-asset mid-rank pct of last_funding_rate vs trailing-180 non-null values (MIN_WINDOW=20); unusable -> neutral 0.5
definitions.inner_cv: train-year dates -> 5 contiguous chunks; inner folds k=1..4 fit chunks[0:k]-embargo, validate chunk k; lambda = argmin mean val MSE; never touches test
definitions.long_only: top-decile EW vs cash, same cost on one-way turnover; excess vs same-day EW universe mean also reported
definitions.mom5: per-asset log(close_t/close_{t-5 bars}) on the PIT close series

purpose: T127: deepen the T125 ML-viable ridge formulation and test net-of-cost tradability. 14 PIT features (v1's 7 plus mom5, vol20_pct, funding_level, xs_rank_mom20, xs_rank_logqvol, mom20*btc_ret20, btc_ret20^2); same walkforward/embargo/inner-CV lambda; per-fold coefficient stability; net tradability via daily EW top/bottom-decile books at 5bps/leg one-way turnover plus a long-only variant; parsimony ablation {dfh20, btc_ret20, dfh20*btc_ret20}. Measurement only.

caveats: 1d book returns autocorrelate little but legs overlap heavily day-to-day (high persistence); Sharpe is nominal, not a t-test
funding_level/funding_pct imputed on ~70% of rows (funding-covered subset ~52/277 symbols)
no borrow/funding-carry/slippage modeling beyond flat 5bps; short leg assumes perp shortability at index
pooled OOS concatenates folds with different train-fitted scales — descriptive
daily rebalance of ~28-name EW legs is turnover-heavy; net results are sensitive to the 5bps assumption
